- **URL:** https://www.agrofil.com.tr/pro-agro-max-20-20-20te/
- **Title:** PRO AGRO MAX 20-20-20+TE

PRO AGRO MAX
(20-20-20+TE)
(PRO AGRO-MAX) complex fertilizer is a comprehensive range
of the most essential plant nutrients - a combination of nitrogen (N),
phosphorus (P) and potassium (K) designed to maximize crop yield
and quality, formulated to meet precise crop requirements, these
NPKS are some of the most highly efficient sources of N, P and K
available. Each PRO AGRO- MAX composition contain precisely
tailored amounts of NPK. So, when accurately applied to a crop,
PRO AGRO-MAX fertilizers ensure the accurate and complete
application of thesemajor nutrients

1 Kg

10 Kg

25 Kg

Chemichal Composition:

PLANT

DOSAGE

DOSAGE

Wheat, Barley, Oat, Rice

250-500 gr/1000 m²

From the leaf after first, second, and third hoeing.

Sugar Beets, Potato, Carrot

250-500 gr/1000 m²

From the leaf after first, second, and third hoeing.

Tomato, Pepper, Cucumber, Eggplant, Pumpkin

2.5 – 5 kg/1000 m²

From soil through drip irrigation once in 7-15 days during the season.

Lettuce, Water Cress, Parsley, Rocke

250-500 gr/1000 m²

From the leaves every 2-3 weeks during the season.

Fruit Trees

2-4 kg/100 lt water

Every 3-4 weeks during the season by drip irrigation.

- **Title:** PRO AGRO MAX 20-20-20+TE

PRO AGRO MAX
(20-20-20+TE)
(PRO AGRO-MAX) kompleks gübre, en temel bitki besinlerinin kapsamlı bir yelpazesidir - ürün verimini ve kalitesini en üst düzeye çıkarmak için tasarlanmış azot (N), fosfor (P) ve potasyum (K) kombinasyonu, hassas ürün gereksinimlerini karşılamak için formüle edilmiştir, bu NPKS'ler mevcut en yüksek verimli N, P ve K kaynaklarından bazılarıdır. Her PRO AGRO-MAX bileşimi hassas bir şekilde uyarlanmış miktarlarda NPK içerir. Bu nedenle, bir ürüne doğru bir şekilde uygulandığında,
PRO AGRO-MAX gübreleri bu temel besin maddelerinin doğru ve eksiksiz bir şekilde uygulanmasını sağlar

1 Kg

10 Kg

25 Kg

Kimyasal Bileşim:

BİTKİ

DOZ

DOZ

Buğday, Arpa, Yulaf, Pirinç

250-500 gr/1000 m²

Birinci, ikinci ve üçüncü çapalamadan sonra yapraktan.

Şeker Pancarı, Patates, Havuç

250-500 gr/1000 m²

Birinci, ikinci ve üçüncü çapalamadan sonra yapraktan.

Domates, Biber, Salatalık, Patlıcan, Balkabağı

2.5 – 5 kg/1000 m²

Sezon boyunca 7-15 günde bir topraktan damla sulama ile.

Marul, Tere, Maydanoz, Roka

250-500 gr/1000 m²

Sezon boyunca 2-3 haftada bir yapraklardan.

Meyve Ağaçları

2-4 kg/100 lt su

Sezon boyunca 3-4 haftada bir damla sulama ile.

body.en:
- **URL:** https://www.agrofil.com.tr/king-root/
- **Title:** KING ROOT

KING ROOT
is a growth promoting liquid fertilizer
consist of fulvic-acid. This product designed to
stimulate the root development and metabolism
of plants and increase plant resistance to abiotic
stress. It act as natural chelators, mobilizing
nutrients in the soil, improving their availability
and uptake by the plant.

1LT

5LT

20 tl

Chemichal Composition:

PLANT

SOİL APPLİCATİON

LEAVES APPLICATION

Vegetables: Tomato, Pepper, Eggplant, Beans, Melon, Watermelon, etc.

For Transplanted Products:

– During transplanting, add 250-500 cc to 100 liters of irrigation water and apply to seedlings.

– In greenhouses, apply 500-1000 cc per decare with drip irrigation, 2-3 times at intervals of 1 month.

When the plant reaches the 3-5 leaf stage, use 100 cc per decare. If necessary, repeat the same dose after 20 days.

Other Tuberous Plants: Potato, Carrot, Onion.

– Broadcasting Application: After preparing the soil for planting, apply 1000 cc per decare.

– Row/Strip Application: Apply 250-500 cc per decare after planting.

When the plant reaches a height of 20-25 cm, use 100 cc per decare. If necessary, repeat the same dose after 20 days.

Field Crops: Cotton, Corn, Cereals, Sunflower.

– Broadcasting Application: After preparing the soil for planting, apply 500-1000 cc per decare.

– Row/Strip Application: Apply 250-500 cc per decare after planting.
